integrity: All mathematical statements were checked symbolically, the exact counterexample was reconstructed directly, and independent randomized finite checks reproduced the algebraic predictions. No independent external review or publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; three-dimensional SPD matrices with two equal eigenvalues, rank-two full-column-rank sketches and strictly positive regularization; spectral condition numbers rather than CG iteration counts; excludes finite-precision stabilization and other preconditioner normalizations.
title: A unique sketch-angle threshold for condition-number reversal in three-state Nyström preconditioning
